summary: Realtime Database root access is denied. launcherProfiles remains restricted to the authenticated owner UID. activeSessions is intentionally public-read for the live count and contains only anonymous UIDs, random session keys, and server timestamps; writes require auth.uid to match the UID path and each session is limited to a numeric lastSeen field. Previous live tests covered launcherProfiles before activeSessions was added; the new presence rules still require live validation.
